newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's Minsur adjusts down 59 pct on stock split.
newsitem.headline: Peru's Minsur adjusts down 59 pct on stock split.

text.p: Peru's Minsur SA stock fell 59 percent in Monday trade on the Lima Stock Exchange in a price adjustment for a share split, brokers said.
The Lima blue chip plummeted to 9.25 soles ($3.59) at 1230 local time/1730 GMT, three and a half hours into the Lima session, down from 22.60 soles at Friday's close.

The world's third largest tin producer has agreed to increase the number of its shares in circulation by 145.5 percent, according to the stock exchange. The new shares will be distributed on December 27. The record date for the split was last Friday,
The split will increase the number of Minsur's shares in circulation to 60.6 million from 24.7 million.
Minsur operates the San Rafael mine in Peru's southern highlands.
